description: Data Repository for Smith et al. Robust Optimization of Green Infrastructure in RHESSys is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Smith, Jared D (deposited on HydroShare). This repository provides data and supplementary information for the following article submitted to the Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management: Smith, J.D., J.D. Quinn, and L.E. Band. Comparing robust optimization approaches for addressing hydrologic model uncertainty in infrastructure planning: A green infrastructure example. Submitted to Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2024-06-17 and last updated 2025-01-13; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
